login.title: Team sign-in
login.note: Demo screen: real sign-in will be connected with the API.

reports.title: Reports and appeals
reports.intro: Work through the queue of reported content. Every decision is recorded and can be appealed.
reports.undoMessage: Decision recorded. You have 6 seconds to undo it.

suspendDialog.title: Suspend this account?
suspendDialog.body: {{author}}'s account will be suspended. You can undo within 6 seconds, or reactivate it later from the Users screen.

jobs.title: Pending job offers
jobs.intro: An offer is only published once the team approves it. Check the company domain and the pay.
jobs.reasonHint: The reason is sent to the company.
jobs.reasonError: The reason must be at least {{count}} characters.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Find a member, suspend or reactivate their account, change their role.

suspendDialog.title: Suspend this account?
suspendDialog.body: {{name}} will not be able to sign in or post until the account is reactivated.

tags.title: Tags
tags.intro: Create tags, merge duplicates, delete unused tags.

create.label: New tag
create.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 30 characters.

tags.deleteDisabled: Only an unused tag can be deleted.

mergeDialog.title: Merge the tag {{name}}
mergeDialog.hint: Questions with the merged tag move to the tag you keep.

challenges.title: Challenges and submissions
challenges.intro: Create a challenge and grade members' repositories out of 100.
challenges.invalidLink: Invalid link, it is not displayed.

form.title: Challenge title
form.titleError: The title must be at least 5 characters.
form.briefError: The brief must be at least 20 characters.

referent.title: Referent view
referent.intro: Moderation by trusted members. You can ignore or hide a piece of content; the author can appeal to the team.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The requested address does not exist in the back office.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.message: This screen could not be displayed. Reload the page; if the problem continues, tell the team.

codes.NETWORK_ERROR: Unable to connect. Check your network and try again.
codes.LOGIN_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
codes.LEVEL_TOO_LOW: Your reputation level does not allow this action.
codes.HTTP_401: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
codes.HTTP_403: You are not allowed to do this.
codes.HTTP_429: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
